caption: The drawing depicts a single long dress with a fitted waist, wide skirt, and voluminous puffed sleeves. The dress is a light creamy beige color and is decorated with a repeated pattern of small, colorful floral motifs. The flowers are in shades of blue, red, and purple, with green leaves and stems, spaced evenly throughout the fabric. The bodice is gathered and structured, with the same floral pattern as the rest of the dress. The sleeves are notably large and rounded, tapering to a more fitted cuff at the wrists, and are constructed with seams emphasized by subtle shading. There are no additional objects or background details present in the drawing.
title: Dress
